item.title: Far from home. Voyager 1 is now farther than anything man has sent into space
item.description: NASA's Voyager 1, which is the furthest man-made object from Earth, is set to reach a new milestone this week. On Wednesday, the probe will be roughly 16 billion miles from Earth.
item.content:encoded:
NASA's Voyager 1, which is the furthest man-made object from Earth, is set to reach a new milestone this week. On Wednesday, the probe will be roughly 16 billion miles from Earth.

item.title: Who makes Sydney Sweeney's American Eagle jeans — and under what conditions?
item.description: Sydney Sweeney has great jeans, American Eagle Outfitters tells us. But who made them? And what are working conditions like in the garment factories of Pakistan and Bangladesh?

item.title: New Orleans port sues owners of tanker involved in Mississippi crash
item.description: Officials are seeking at least $1 million in damages from the owners of the tanker that hit a cruise ship last week. The incident was dubbed "the miracle on the Mississippi" after no one was killed.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Laws limiting coal miners' exposure to toxic dust are in danger of being rolled back
item.description: Coal miners who are exposed to silica dust are at a higher risk of black lung disease. Despite decades of advocacy, new efforts to regulate the toxic dust are under threat.

item.description: A year ago in November, New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to every eligible family, regardless of income.

item.title: Midterm voters ended the long-running GOP dominance in state legislatures
item.description: In several states, Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and they weakened GOP dominance in others. Issues on the agenda: More access to health care, new limits on school vouchers.

item.description: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.

item.title: FAA ground stop disrupts college football
item.description: Some college football games were delayed a few hours on Saturday or postponed to Sunday. And in Oklahoma at least, there will be perks for fans to make up for the inconvenience, including cheap beers.
